senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; רצץ; Ch. a. oth. dial. ארע fr. רעע to press together, stamp—from the rugged appearance of the surface after the subsidence of the waters) earth, dry land; country, land, field (opp. to town).
units: Ex. R. s. 13 … threw dust upon the waters ונעשה א׳ and earth (crust) was formed.—א׳ ישראל (abbr. א״י) Palestine, opp. חוצה לָאָ׳, or מדינת הים foreign countries, or distant countries.

Ib. 6ᵃ; a. fr.—הָאָרֶץ Palestine, Ḥull. 16ᵇ משנכנסו לא׳ since entering Palestine (under Joshua); a. fr.—עם הָאָ׳ (abbr. ע״ה) country people, hence illiterate, coarse, unrefined (often applied to an individual); pl. עַמֵּי הא׳, opp. תלמיד חכם.
Ḥull. 92ᵃ; a. v. fr.—Esp. ע״ה those not observing certain religious customs regarding tithes, levitical cleanness &c., opp. חָבֵר q. v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:2">Dem. I, 2</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="A03231"><he>אֲרָצוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:2">Shebi. IX, 2</cite> <he>שלש א׳ וכ׳</he> Palestine is divided into three countries with reference to the laws of the Sabbath year.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:1">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="P00629"><he>עִיסָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
